accuracy: We additionally report global argmax accuracy; reference averages per-batch accuracies, which can differ on the final partial batch
aenet_caveat: README imports AENET results; exact evaluator identity for those imported results is not established
apcer_reference: FP / real_count (real classified attack), corresponds to project BPCER at argmax threshold
bpcer_reference: FN / attack_count (attack classified real), corresponds to project APCER at argmax threshold
comparison_caveat: Same full split scope as confirmed by user; scored population can differ with localization/preprocessing. Metric-compatible comparison is not identical preprocessing.
eer: min(FPR,FNR) at first nanargmin(abs(FNR-FPR)); no interpolation
population_protocol: Full official CelebA Test and pooled full LCC, confirmed by user; no further population audit requested
preprocessing: Reference tight crops, RGB 128x128 normalized; project frozen SCRFD crop1.5, BGR 80x80 [0,1]. Impact is not measured.
project_metrics: Preserved real-positive logit difference, source-calibrated threshold, ISO rate names, averaged FPR/FNR EER
reference_snapshot_caveat: LCC registry entries are commented at this pinned snapshot; constants are published README results, not reproduced runs.
units: AUC fraction; computed rates fractions; published README EER/APCER/BPCER/ACER percent; params millions; GFLOPs as published
